alice.dev: Heads-up — we're scheduling a short control-plane maintenance tonight to rotate a routing policy that we've seen cause rare packet drops. Window: 2026-03-18 22:00–23:00 PST. No expected model-serving downtime, but we'll run a targeted router drain and validate traffic routing. Please review comms below and volunteer a day/night handoff.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ID mnt-20260318-01. Reminders will be posted 2h and 15m before start. Link: https://ops.status/redwood/mnt-20260318-01

sre-oncall: I can take the 22:00–00:00 shift, will be on pager during the drain and validation steps. If anything looks abnormal I’ll escalate to ben.ops.

ben.ops: ack. I'll watch the autoscaler and GPU pools during the window (00:00–02:00 monitoring). If we see >3% request latency tail increase I'll trigger rollback.

carla-cs: prepping customer comms. Draft below — please sanity-check tone and impact language.

carla-cs: ```
Subject: Planned maintenance — brief routing rotation (Mar 18, 22:00 PST)

Hi —
We will perform a brief maintenance to rotate an internal routing policy to improve reliability.
Impact: controlled router drain. No expected downtime for inference; some requests may experience transient latency (expected < 2s) for up to 10 minutes.
When: 2026-03-18 22:00–23:00 PST
If you rely on strict latency SLOs during that window please contact support and we can discuss options.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

alice.dev: wording looks good, maybe add an explicit rollback line: "We will rollback immediately if we detect customer-facing errors."

carla-cs: added. Also added a short in-console banner draft: 

carla-cs: ```
Maintenance: Router rotation in progress — small latency increases possible. Window: Mar 18 22:00–23:00 PST. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai
```

support-engineer: Customer-facing SLAs — if any paying customers report >10% error rate we'll issue a priority incident and provide proactive credits. We'll include that in the support queue doc.

sre-oncall: Runbook highlights (condensed):
```
1) Pre-checks (T-60m): verify capacity, drain tokens in the target router group.
2) Start window (T0): apply routing change to 10% host canary. Wait 120s. Check 99p latency and error rate.
3) Ramp to 100% over 10m if checks pass.
4) Post-checks (T+30m): KV cache hit-rate, prefix-cache warmth, no sustained error spikes.
5) Abort: immediate rollback if error rate >0.5% or p50 latency > baseline + 500ms.
```

ben.ops: I'm adding a quick monitoring dashboard snippet to the ops runbook: `watch -n 10 'curl -s https://internal-metrics/api/latency | jq .p99'` — will leave that in the runbook.

alice.dev: Who will update the status page at each milestone? I can post T+0 and completion if no issues. ben.ops can post the rollback/incident if needed.

sre-oncall: I'll post the mid-window validation note at T+15 and annotate traces.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2 hours until maintenance (trigger at 2765439300).

(22:00 PST) sre-oncall: starting canary now — applying to group A (10%). monitoring p50/p99 and error-rate.

ben.ops: seeing a tiny bump p99 +120ms, errors still within baseline. continuing to ramp to 50%.

sre-oncall: ramp to 50% done. p99 stable +150ms, error-rate 0.02%. holding for 2m.

support-engineer: pinging top-20 enterprise customers with a short heads-up per the draft. No replies yet.

sre-oncall: ramping to 100%.

(22:12 PST) ben.ops: full ramp complete. No visible customer-facing errors. KV cache warmed within expected timeframe.

carla-cs: updating the customer banner to: "Maintenance in progress — minimal latency impact possible. We'll post completion at 23:00 PST." :loudspeaker:

(22:45 PST) sre-oncall: running post-checks — all metrics look green. Will keep monitoring until 23:00.

(23:00 PST) alice.dev: maintenance complete. No customer-facing incidents. Posting final status page update and sending closure email. Thanks everyone for the quick handoffs. :tada:

alice.dev: Final status page note (posted): ```
Status: Completed — Router rotation succeeded with no customer-facing impact.
Window: Mar 18 22:00–23:00 PST
Details: Canaries ramped, KV caches warmed. No rollbacks performed.
```

incident-bot: Maintenance mnt-20260318-01 marked complete. Notifications sent.

ben.ops: Marking runbook tweaks: add a 3m extra hold between 50%->100% ramp for future windows (PR incoming). :memo:

carla-cs: final customer email sent. Will attach monitoring screenshots and a short timeline for customers who request it.

support-engineer: closing support thread unless customers surface any post-maint issues.
